name: NAVSIM
description: A real-data, non-reactive short-horizon simulator that balances scalability with stronger closed-loop correlation than displacement-only metrics.

name: Bench2Drive
description: A multi-ability CARLA closed-loop benchmark spanning interactive scenarios, weather conditions, and multiple towns.

name: nuPlan
description: A large-scale real-world planning dataset and reactive closed-loop simulation framework with general and scenario-specific metrics.

name: CARLA Leaderboard 2.0
description: Interactive closed-loop evaluation on public CARLA routes, traffic events, and unseen conditions.

name: nuScenes Planning
description: A widely used open-loop trajectory-planning protocol. Results are useful for reproducibility but must be separated from closed-loop safety claims.

name: DriveLM
description: Graph visual question answering that connects perception, prediction, and planning across nuScenes and CARLA driving scenes.

name: Reason2Drive
description: A video-text benchmark for interpretable chain-based driving reasoning over perception, prediction, and decisions.

name: DriveBench
description: A reliability benchmark for driving VLMs across clean, corrupted, and text-only inputs, covering perception, prediction, behavior, and planning.
